problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Find a zero of a differentiable monotone operator F:E→E. Its Jacobian is H(x)+S, where S is fixed skew-adjoint and H(x) is self-adjoint positive semidefinite. No scalar objective or saddle representation is supplied.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Two exact oracles return F(x) and the full Jacobian DF(x), respectively. Answers are independent of history and seed. Each oracle has a separate fixed call budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For H(x)=DF(x)−S, 0≼H(y)≼exp(M‖y−x‖)H(x) for all x,y. The fixed skew-adjoint part S is unrestricted. Also ‖DF(x)‖≤Λ within distance 3D+1/(4M) of a root xstar.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, with its induced norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: A root xstar exists with ‖x0−xstar‖≤D. The space, x0, M>0, D>0 and ε>0 are public; Λ≥0 is hidden. Neither S nor xstar is supplied to the algorithm.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HessianStableSkewMonotone.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual bound holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed distribution; deterministic output is not required.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return one point x with unsquared operator residual ‖F(x)‖≤ε.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The monotone root problem imposes multiplicative stability on the positive semidefinite Jacobian component while allowing an unrestricted fixed skew component, with a hidden local Jacobian bound and an almost-sure residual criterion.
